title: Explicit higher order rational rogue waves of the nonlinear Schrödinger equation
summary: The $N$-th order rational rogue wave of the nonlinear Schrödinger equation (NLS), which depends on $2 N-2$ real parameters, has been shown to be impossible to generate by the nonlinear superposition formula. We here generate this sequence by a three-term recurrence relation, each step only requiring the computation of three $N-1$-th order determinants of $2 N-2$ variables, while the previous method requires two determinants of order $2 N$ in $2 N$ variables.
